title: Multi-phase production with scrap, rework capacity, and final quality constraint
text: A factory produces 89 items per day for 31 days with defect rate 0.232. Defectives can be reworked at capacity 37 items/day with success probability 0.888; unreworked defectives are scrapped and failed reworks are scrapped. For the next 9 days, production increases to 101 but defect rate becomes 0.293 unless the cumulative scrap so far exceeds 60, in which case defect rate reduces to 0.281 due to extra inspection cost 2984 per day. Find the expected number of sellable items and the expected total inspection cost.
